brand.name: IGshorts
brand.mission: Public charts of famous Instagram people on our tracked watchlist, ranked by public follower count. Not all of Instagram. Not impressions.

disclaimer.editorial: IGshorts tracks a curated universe of public accounts, not the entire Instagram graph. Follower counts reflect point-in-time public snapshots. We never scrape private data or guess missing metrics.

methodology.title: Editorial & Ranking Methodology
methodology.subtitle: How IGshorts gathers public data, enforces competition ranking, and maintains absolute transparency.

points.watchlist: Tracked Watchlist: We monitor a defined, verified universe of high-impact public personalities across Global and Indian categories rather than attempting to scrape the full Instagram graph.
points.persons_only: Persons-Only Leaderboards: Corporate brands, sports franchises, and platform accounts are isolated from the main charts to keep individual creator rankings pure and comparable.
points.metric_precision: Verified Followers: Rankings are calculated exclusively on public follower counts. We never use opaque engagement scores or impressions.
points.null_handling: Honest Null Handling: Accounts with missing follower numbers are marked unranked and excluded from competition ranks. We never coerce null values into zero.
points.competition_rank: Standard Competition Ranking: Tied metrics receive identical ranks (e.g. 1, 2, 2, 4), with secondary sorting by alphabetical handle for visual clarity.
points.cadence: Systematic Observation Cadence: Metrics are appended non-destructively to produce verifiable rank deltas (↑, ↓, –) between sequential observation runs.

states.unranked_explanation: This profile is part of our tracked universe, but does not yet have a verified follower snapshot from the latest ranking run. Missing metrics remain null and are never guessed as zero.
states.baseline_history: Baseline snapshot recorded. Trendline history will display following subsequent observation runs.
states.empty_movers: Baseline snapshot active. Rank movers require at least two sequential observation runs to compute verified deltas.
states.error_banner: Unable to connect to the IGshorts API. No placeholder ranks are shown.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our tracked universe, metrics, and ranking standards.
faq.official_a: No. IGshorts is an independent editorial dashboard. We are not affiliated with Meta or Instagram.
faq.impressions_q: Why don’t you rank by impressions or engagement?
faq.impressions_a: v1 ranks only on public follower count. Impressions and similar metrics are not public for these accounts and are not used.
